sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Tenor: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a third every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor
